text: CreateSubfolderAsync wraps a URL-stop listener. Failed operation or child lookup rejects the promise; a successful lookup with no object rejects NS_MSG_ERROR_FOLDER_MISSING, and only an actual folder resolves it. UrlListener forwards the completion status to that lambda. The IDL error wording must not be read as a promise resolving an error code. The wrapper does not inspect the listener method immediate return, so this source is not an all-protocol settlement guarantee; no runtime test ran.
title: Folder creation promises settle from the listener status and created-child lookup
